overview: While you waited you had the part on your knee and the head of it turned under. No name showed. You shut it again before anyone asked.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read with the head covered, and shut the roll.

key_provisions.text: the covered head of the roll

assets.name: the part-roll
assets.disposition: Turned the head of the roll under

important_dates.meaning: Kept the head of the part turned under

summary: Turned the head of the roll under
